css-box-shadow-generator.name: CSS Box Shadow Generator
css-box-shadow-generator.description: Design layered CSS box shadows with inset, color and opacity controls, a local preview, copy and download.

meta.title: CSS Box Shadow Generator
meta.description: Design layered CSS box shadows with inset, color and opacity controls, a local preview, copy and download.
meta.keywords: CSS Box Shadow Generator, CSS, box-shadow, inset, rgba

boxShadow.emptyResult: Configure the layers and generate CSS to preview the shadow.
boxShadow.hint: Use 1–8 layers. All numeric values must be whole numbers; colors use six hexadecimal digits (#RRGGBB).
boxShadow.previewHint: Preview uses the generated CSS. Large shadows are clipped to this preview area; card styling is not included in the download.
boxShadow.rules: The first shadow is painted on top. Negative spread shrinks a shadow. This tool generates box-shadow for boxes; regenerate after editing.
boxShadow.integer: Layer {number}: enter a whole number without units, decimals or exponent notation.
boxShadow.offsetRange: Layer {number}: offsets and spread must be between −500 and 500 px.
boxShadow.blurRange: Layer {number}: blur radius must be between 0 and 500 px.
boxShadow.opacityRange: Layer {number}: opacity must be between 0 and 100%.
boxShadow.invalidColor: Layer {number}: enter a color as #RRGGBB, for example #2563eb.
